connector.name: Gemini Researcher
connector.registryDescription: Stateless MCP server that proxies research queries to Gemini CLI, reducing agent context/model usage
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gemini-researcher. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the capybearista account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Gemini API key (optional if you already authenticated Gemini CLI via "gemini" login)

env.name: PROJECT_ROOT
env.description: Override the project root directory used for path validation (defaults to current working directory)

env.name: RESPONSE_CHUNK_SIZE_KB
env.description: Chunk size threshold (KB) for large responses (default: 10)

env.name: CACHE_TTL_MS
env.description: Chunk cache TTL in milliseconds (default: 3600000 / 1 hour)

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Vertex AI / Google auth: path to a service account JSON credentials file

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: Vertex AI / Google auth: GCP project ID (used by some auth configurations)

env.name: VERTEX_AI_PROJECT
env.description: Vertex AI / Google auth: Vertex AI project identifier (used by some auth configurations)
